SSE feed of recent events, polled from Postgres.

v1 keeps this deliberately dumb: one query per poll tick, no broker
fan-out. At 5–50 concurrent UI clients this is a rounding error on
Postgres, and it removes a pub/sub dependency from the UI path.

Depth + consumer lag per stream (PRD §10.1).

undelivered comes from streams.undelivered_count() — NULL-safe lag with
a live-count fallback (2026-09-12: XINFO lag=None after XDEL cleanup
collapsed to 0 here, and the main dashboard disagreed with the pipeline
page). Errors propagate: a dead Redis must not read as an empty queue.

Aggregate snapshot for the pipeline live view (web /pipeline page).

One call answers: is every component up, how deep is each queue lane,
who is holding in-flight work, and how fast are shards settling.

post.description:
Batch delete or batch re-parse over doc_ids. Fail-closed scope
checks: every doc_id must resolve (422 otherwise) and every resolved
collection must fall within the key's allowlist (403 otherwise) before
anything is applied — never partially.

get.description:
KB-wide paginated chunk browsing across all documents in the
collection, with an optional per-doc narrowing (Chunk Inspector, KB tab).

Env-configured runtime constants (chunking, splitting, retry
ladder, backpressure, search caps) as a read-only projection of
config.Settings — the KB Settings tab's chunking preview data source.
